paite: Huan Mosi in, Israel mite teng kiang ah hiai thu agen hi.
heading: Joshua In Mosi Tha Akhengkhia

paite: “Tu in kum za-le-sawmnih ka hita a; ka vialvak zou nawn kei. TOUPA'N 'Hiai Jordan lui na kan kei ding,' ahon chi hi.
TOUPA na Pathian un na ma uh api dia, hiai namte ahon hihsiatsak dia, agam uh na luah ding uh. TOUPA'N ana gensa bang in Joshua in na ma uh api ding hi.
TOUPA'N Amorte kumpipa, Sihon leh Og leh agam tung ua ahih bang in atung uah ahih dia; amaute ahihse ding hi.
TOUPA'N amaute ahon pe dia, thu ka hon piak thupiak tengteng atung uah na hih ding uhi.
Kuhkaltak leh hangsantak in om un. Lau kei unla, kihta sam kei un. Na kiang ua hon pepa TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi ngal a. Ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding," achi hi.

Mosi in Joshua asam a, Israel mi tengteng mitmuh in akiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Hiai mite toh akiang ua api-le-pute uh TOUPA'N kichiam a piak ana chiamsa gam ah na lut ngeingei ding ua, amaute na luahsak ding ahi.
heading: Mosi In Joshua Thuhilhna

paite: Na ma uh pipa TOUPA ahi dia, na kiang ah a-om zel dia, ahon vuallelsak kei dia, pai leng hon paisan kei hial ding hi. Lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n," achi hi.
Mosi in dan agelh a, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levi tapa siampute leh Israel upate tengteng apia hi.
heading: Kum Sagihna Teng A Dan Sim Ding

paite: Mosi in, amau thu apia a, "Kum sagih kum, ngaihdam kum teng a Biakbuk Ankuangluina,
mun aseh dia Israel mi tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a hong kilat chiang un, hiai dan Israel tengteng zak in na sim ding uh ahi.

Mipite, numei leh pasal, na taneu chikchikte uh, na ompih uh gamdang mite, amau angaihkhiak ua, akisin ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan asiam ua, hiai dan thu tengteng pilvangtak a azuihtheihna ding uh leh
atate uh athei nailoute'n leng azak ua, Jordan lui kan a na va luah ding uh gam a na ten sung teng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam akisintheihna ding un samkhawm in," achi hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sih hun ahong naita; Joshua sam inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah va kihil in, amau thu ka pe ding hi,” achi hi. Huchi in Mosi leh Joshua ahoh ua, kihoupihna biakbuk ah ava kihil uhi.
heading: Mosi Kiang A TOUPA Thukhah Nanung

paite: TOUPA puanin ah meipi ding in akilak a; meipi ding puanın kongpl lutung ah adingh hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na pi-le-pute kiang ah na ihmu ding hi. Hiai mite athou ding ua, ava tenna dingte uh lak ah huai gam pathiante lak ah ang a kawm ding ua, ahon lehngatsan ding ua, ka thukhun akiang ua ka khun abohse ding uh.

Huchi in huai ni in atung uah ka heh dia, ka lehngatsan dia, ka kibuk mangsan dia, hihsiat in a-om ding uh. Thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung uah atung ding hi. Huchi in huai ni in, i Pathian uh i lak ua a-om louh ziak in hiai thil hoih lou i tung ua hong tung ahi kei maw? achi ding uh.
Pathian dangte lam nga a thil hoih lou ahih ding tengteng uh ziak in huai.ni in ka kibuksan ngeingei ding hi.
Huaiziak in tu in 'hiai la gelh inla, Israel suante sinsak inla, akam uah koih in. Hiai la Israel suante kalhna a kei a dia theihpihtu ahihtheihna ding in.

Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam, nawitui leh khuaizu luang gam ah ka pi a, ne leh ta in a-om ua,.atai ua, ahong thau hial chiang un.pathian dangte lam anga ding ua, a-nna uh asem ding ua, kei hon hehsak ding ua, ka thukhun abohse ding uh'.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, thil hoih lou leh mangbatna tampi atung ua ahong tun chiang in, hiai la akhelhna uh theihpihtu ahi ding. Asuante kam a pan mangngilh theih ahi kei ding hi. Tu in ka kichiam gam a ka pilut ma him in leng alunggel uh akawidan ka thei hi," achi hi.
Huchi in Mosi in, huai la, huai ni mahmah in agelh a, Israel suante asinsak hi.
heading: Mosi Laphuah

paite: Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah hiai thupiak apia hi. "Hattak leh hangsantak in om in. Israel suante kiang a ka kichiam bang in huai gam ah na pilut ding hi. Na kiang ah ka om ding," achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi in hiai dan thute laibu agelh khit a mansa ahih vek nung in,
TOUPA thukhun bawm zawng Levite Mosi in thu apia hi.
"Hiai Dan Bu la unla, noute kalh a theihpihtu hi ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thukhun bawm sik ah koih un.
heading: Levite Thupiak

paite: Na helhatdan uh leh na paupendan uh ka thei hi. Ngai un, tua ka hon dampih lai a bawn TOUPA tung a hel na hi ua; ka sih nung ngial in houh bangchi phet in anasazaw diam aw?
"Abil ua zak a hiai thu ka gen a, noute kalh a theihpihtu dia lei leh van ka saptheihna ding in na nam ua intekpen tengteng leh na heutute uh hon samkhawm un.
heading: Israel Upa Thuhilhna

paite: Ka sih nung in nakpitak in na kihihse ding ua, ka hon thupiak lampi a pan na pial ding uh chih ka thei kilkel hi. Atawp chiang ngial in houh thil hoih lou in hon buakkhum dia; na khut thilhih ua hihheh ding in TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih ding ziak un," achi hi.
Mosi in, Israel kikhawmkhawm tengteng zak in hiai la thu abul a pan atawp pha in agen vek hi.
